name: Shinobikuni
source:
Died at the age of 27.

Abbess of the Kumonoi Temple in Asakusa, and an ex-prisoner who was saved by the Spider's Thread. She descended to the Human Realm to spread the word of Buddhism to humans.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/shinobikuni/]Aksys Games[/url]]
